subtopics.title: Thomson and Rutherford models with evidence

slots.X: Why is rare high-angle deflection significant for the nucleus model?
slots.Y: What did Rutherford's gold-foil experiment reveal that Thomson's model could not explain? Connect observed scattering distribution to charge concentration while distinguishing observation and model.
slots.Z: Most alpha particles go nearly straight: the atom is mostly open space on this scale; rare backscattering supports concentrated nuclear charge.
slots.W: Learner independently performs the decisive EXPLAIN inference required by: Why is rare high-angle deflection significant for the nucleus model?

qrt_instances.replacement_rule: Separate frequent observations from rare high-angle events.
qrt_instances.visual_job: Diagram alpha rays on a foil: most straight, few large deflections. Separate observed tracks from inferred compact nucleus.

slots.Z: Rutherford's compact nucleus gives both; Thomson's diffuse positive region fails at large angles.

subtopics.title: Bohr shells and electrons for the first 18 elements

slots.X: Why is Al commonly represented as forming Al³⁺ in ionic compound bookkeeping?
slots.Y: Why does magnesium show the shell pattern 2,8,2 rather than putting all 12 electrons together? The outer-shell count supports a model for ion formation but does not by itself prove a reaction.
slots.Z: Mg (2,8,2) often loses two electrons to reach a neon-like arrangement, giving Mg²⁺.
slots.W: Learner independently performs the decisive EXPLAIN inference required by: Why is Al commonly represented as forming Al³⁺ in ionic compound bookkeeping?

slots.X: Why can an atom emit light at discrete frequencies rather than any arbitrary frequency when its electronic energies are quantised?
slots.Y: Why do modern electron configurations use 3d and 4s notation when earlier shell diagrams seem sufficient? Spectral lines support discrete energy differences; emitted light carries energy corresponding to a transition.
slots.Z: E=hν means a higher photon frequency corresponds to higher energy in this model.

qrt_instances.student_task: Why can an atom emit light at discrete frequencies rather than any arbitrary frequency when its electronic energies are quantised?
qrt_instances.wrong_idea: Always remove 3d electrons before 4s because 3d has a smaller leading number.
